notes: Implemented a pure, offline DockClickMapper: maps a raw QML activated(string) to immutable ClickIntent (LAUNCH/FOCUS/REJECT/IGNORE). Fixed eight-label allowlist mirrors prototype/classic/SystemAppLauncher.cpp. Untrusted IDs, case/path/command/injection variants and non-str inputs REJECT untrusted-id with no state change. Approved-but-missing targets and disabled launcher REJECT missing-target. Running target FOCUSes; installed+not-running LAUNCHes; a second click while a launch is pending returns IGNORE so no duplicate launch occurs. Host reports state via observe(); no polling, threads, network, OS/Qt imports, privileged calls or unbounded state (all sets bounded by 8 labels). Tests cover untrusted IDs, missing targets, repeated clicks and bounded state. Ran on Windows host only; behavior is platform-neutral by construction (pure Python, no OS/Qt dependency). No test of real Linux Mint, a compiled Qt binary, or a live desktop was run; do not claim one. Future integration still needed: wire this component into the compiled Qt application (connect DockTile.activated to the host launcher/window focus) to prove a working desktop. No protected paths, artwork, QML, C++, wallpaper, workflows or main touched. No commit, push, PR or branch change performed; supervisor publishes.
